title: At the dry cleaner's
instructions: Bir adam kuru temizlemeciye takım elbise bırakıyor. Kısa bir diyalog; süre ve fiyata dikkat et.

script.speaker: man
script.text: Hi. Can you clean this suit by Friday? I've got a wedding on Saturday.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, it'll be ready on Thursday afternoon.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Twelve pounds. You pay when you collect it.
